#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root="$HOME/.local/share/ji-host"
for directory in "$root"/operations/install-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT-*; do
  test -d "$directory" || continue
  printf 'OPERATION=%s\n' "$directory"
  for file in activated complete ports previous-target; do
    if test -f "$directory/$file"; then printf '%s=yes\n' "$file"; else printf '%s=no\n' "$file"; fi
  done
done
printf 'CURRENT=%s\n' "$(readlink "$root/current")"
printf 'SERVICE='
systemctl --user show ji-host.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ExecMainStatus --value | tr '\n' ','
printf '\n'
if test -f "$root/run/host-locator"; then
  rest=$(sed -n 's/^rest=//p' "$root/run/host-locator")
  "$root/current/bin/ji-host" --health-check "http://127.0.0.1:$rest/api/v1/health/ready"
  printf '%s\n' CURRENT_READY
fi
